title: Q-SPEC-03-R11-seed-step-evidence: Write one evidence row per tick step in the seed tick
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-03-R11" -- seed/worker/test
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-03 (US-03-R11): the seed tick (`seed/worker/src/tick.js`) writes one `tick_runs` row per tick with step counts; `workers/core/kernel` writes one evidence row per sub-step and files missing rows. Record per step whether it ran, was deferred or failed (tick id, step, state, note) under retention, and have the pulse step file a slot whose step rows are missing.

size: M

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** changing the step order or the deferral rules of section 3.4.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-03-R11" -- seed/worker/test` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
